availability: SkinVision is currently available in various countries in Europe (Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Italy, Spain, UK) and Oceania (Australia, New Zealand). It is not yet available in the United States, pending FDA authorization and applicable regulatory clearance.
summary: SkinVision is a health technology solution that enables users to upload images of skin lesions. It provides AI-assisted risk assessments to increase skin health awareness and support early detection of skin cancer, prompting users to seek medical advice if a high-risk assessment is given.
medicalPurpose: To increase skin health awareness and facilitate the early detection of skin cancer by providing risk assessments of skin lesions.
acceptableInput: Images of skin lesions (JPEG/PNG/BMP/TIFF/WebP, max 20 MB) and patient metadata (age, sex, anatomical site).
output: The model provides an AI-assisted classification of skin lesions, a confidence score, prediction entropy, and a Grad-CAM heatmap for visual explanation. This output is used to generate a risk assessment (e.g., high-risk) or classification (e.g., Melanoma, Nevus, Basal Cell Carcinoma).
roleInDecisionMaking: The AI predictions are advisory only and are intended to assist users in becoming more aware of their skin health and to prompt them to consult a qualified dermatologist for professional medical diagnosis. The model does not replace clinical judgment.
intendedUsers: Individuals who want to monitor their skin over time and increase their awareness of skin health.
targetPatientPopulation: Not explicitly specified in the provided sources.
